title: Wire a single-phase consumer unit
description: Candidate must correctly wire an 8-way consumer unit with RCD protection, label all circuits, and pass an insulation resistance test.
assessment_criteria: All live, neutral, and earth conductors correctly terminated
No dead shorts on any circuit

title: Install a basin and waste trap

title: Construct a mortise-and-tenon joint
